profile.acquisition: Acquired by Barclays Capital on 22 September 2008 as part of its purchase of Lehman Brothers North American investment banking and capital markets business. The bankruptcy court set the real estate consideration at 1.29 billion dollars, of which 330 million dollars was for the two New Jersey data centers, Cranford and Piscataway, together; the split between the two sites was not disclosed.

reading:
Barclays is a United Kingdom-headquartered bank, not a commercial data center or colocation operator, and its SEC filers, Barclays PLC and Barclays Bank PLC, are foreign private issuers rather than US domestic registrants. Facilities tagged to Barclays in this registry are almost certainly private enterprise data centers supporting the bank's own technology and trading operations, not third-party colocation space, so this entry records Barclays as an enterprise-private operator type rather than a commercial one.

Barclays opened a major US technology campus in Whippany, New Jersey in July 2018, described in its own press release as a world-class campus, with later local business press reporting continued job growth there. This Whippany campus is the most likely anchor for the New Jersey facilities this registry tracks under the Barclays name.

The registry here tracks 2 Barclays facilities, both in New Jersey. Because Barclays' data centers exist to serve its own banking operations rather than external customers, this operator differs structurally from every commercial colocation and hyperscale operator recorded elsewhere in this registry, and its facilities should be understood as enterprise-owned infrastructure rather than leasable capacity.
